items.prompt: Which of these animals is a mollusc?

options.label: A shrimp
options.feedback: Shrimp are crustaceans, not molluscs. Molluscs include groups like clams, octopuses, and snails.

options.label: An octopus
options.feedback: Correct. Octopuses are cephalopods, which are a type of mollusc.

options.label: A lobster
options.feedback: Lobsters are crustaceans, not molluscs. Molluscs include squids, clams, and whelks.

options.label: A crab
options.feedback: Crabs are crustaceans, not molluscs. Molluscs include bivalves like oysters and gastropods like snails.

items.ok_line: An octopus is a cephalopod mollusc.
items.ko_line: Shrimp, lobsters, and crabs are crustaceans.
items.exp_text: Molluscs include cephalopods (squids, octopuses, cuttlefish), bivalves (clams, oysters), and gastropods (whelks, winkles, snails). Crustaceans are a separate group that includes shrimp, lobsters, and crabs.

items.prompt: What kind of animals are crustaceans most closely related to?

options.label: Insects and arachnids
options.feedback: Correct. Crustaceans are arthropods, and they are closely related to insects and arachnids.

options.label: Molluscs and echinoderms
options.feedback: Molluscs and echinoderms are not closely related to crustaceans; crustaceans belong to the arthropod group with insects and arachnids.

options.label: Fish and reptiles
options.feedback: Fish and reptiles are vertebrates, while crustaceans are invertebrates, so they are not close relatives.

options.label: Corals and jellyfish
options.feedback: Corals and jellyfish are cnidarians, which are not close to crustaceans; the close relatives are insects and arachnids.

items.ok_line: Crustaceans are arthropods related to insects and arachnids.
items.ko_line: Crustaceans are not close to molluscs or vertebrates.
items.exp_text: Crustaceans are a subphylum of the phylum Arthropoda, which also includes insects and arachnids, so they share a common ancestry with those groups.

items.prompt: Which of these is an example of a bivalve?

options.label: A squid
options.feedback: Squid are cephalopods, not bivalves. Bivalves have two shells, like clams and oysters.

options.label: A snail
options.feedback: Snails are gastropods, not bivalves. Bivalves have two hinged shells.

options.label: An oyster
options.feedback: Correct. Oysters are bivalves, having two shells, as are clams and mussels.

options.label: A whelk
options.feedback: Whelks are gastropods, not bivalves. Bivalves are filter feeders with two shells, like clams.

items.ok_line: Oysters are bivalves with two shells.
items.ko_line: Squids, snails, and whelks are not bivalves.
items.exp_text: Bivalves are molluscs with two shells, such as clams, oysters, mussels, and scallops. Other mollusc groups include cephalopods and gastropods.

items.prompt: Which of these animals is an echinoderm?

options.label: A crab
options.feedback: Crabs are crustaceans, not echinoderms. Echinoderms include sea urchins and starfish.

options.label: A sea urchin
options.feedback: Correct. Sea urchins are echinoderms, and their gonads are eaten as a delicacy.

options.label: A barnacle
options.feedback: Barnacles are crustaceans, not echinoderms. Echinoderms have radial symmetry.

options.label: An octopus
options.feedback: Octopuses are molluscs, not echinoderms. Echinoderms are a separate group like sea urchins.

items.ko_line: Crabs, barnacles, and octopuses are not echinoderms.
items.exp_text: Echinoderms are a group of marine invertebrates that includes sea urchins, although they are not harvested as often as molluscs or crustaceans. They differ from arthropods and molluscs.

items.prompt: Which of these is a type of mollusc that has a single shell?

options.label: A clam
options.feedback: Clams are bivalves with two shells, not single-shelled molluscs.

options.label: An oyster
options.feedback: Oysters are bivalves with two shells, not single-shelled molluscs.

options.label: A snail
options.feedback: Correct. Snails are gastropods, which often have a single shell.

options.label: A scallop
options.feedback: Scallops are bivalves with two shells, not single-shelled molluscs.

items.ok_line: Snails are gastropods with a single shell.
items.ko_line: Clams, oysters, and scallops are bivalves with two shells.
items.exp_text: Gastropods like snails have a single shell, while bivalves like clams and oysters have two shells. Cephalopods like octopuses often have no external shell.
